concept: Extending compassion to someone who has wronged you, without excusing what they did
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student encounters someone who previously wronged them now struggling with something difficult
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to extend compassion, while still holding the past wrong as real
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how compassion and accountability can coexist

assessment.success_marker: student distinguishes compassion from excusing or forgetting what happened
